1 """R3 of the steward-responsiveness plan (Ecgberht/planning/steward-responsiveness-2026-10-04, John 2026-10-04: "It is
2 fine to have the Cave Steward and the Star Steward both hand off to other agents ... but I don't want to have it not
3 use the best model at the fullest effort for hard problems").
4 
5 A steward hands real work to a CODE JOB and stays free to talk. A code job is a workbench-terminal engine (the same
6 bridges, the same latest-model / highest-effort policy as every steward) running in its own git worktree of the
7 repository that owns the files, given the steward's brief as its first message. When its turn ends the job is
8 checked (the brief's check command, when one was given), committed on its branch, and landed into the repository
9 when that is clean; then the steward that commissioned it is woken with the result and reports it to John.
10 
11 One writer: while a job runs on a repository, the steward does not write there (the engine's tool guard reads
12 ``active_repos``). His "stop" kills the job; a change he asks for is held for the result turn, never piped into the
13 running job. One coder by default; a swarm only when his brief asks for one (the coder may fan out itself).
14 
15 Records: ``<steward folder>/.ecgberht/code-jobs.json`` {job_id: {...}}. Never raises to a caller; every failure is a
16 record field and a line to the steward.
17 """

41 def _git(repo, *args, timeout=120):
42     try:
43         r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=timeout)
44     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
45         return 1, "", "git %s timed out after %ss" % (args[0] if args else "", timeout)
46     except Exception as e:
47         return 1, "", "git could not run: %s" % e
48     return r.returncode, (r.stdout or "").strip(), (r.stderr or "").strip()

100 def busy_repos():
101     """Every repository a live code job owns, across all stewards: {repo: {"job", "cdir"}} (stale entries dropped)."""

115 def inside(path, repo):
116     """True when ``path`` is ``repo`` or under it, on a path boundary (C:\\dev\\Anchor never matches C:\\dev\\Anchor-x)."""
117     p, r = _norm(path), _norm(repo)
118     return p == r or p.startswith(r.rstrip(os.sep) + os.sep)

121 def _transition(cdir, job_id, expect, **updates):
122     """One locked status change: applies ``updates`` only when the job's status is in ``expect``; returns the job
123     after the change, or None when it was not in that state (finish and stop never both win)."""
124     with _LOCK:
125         d = read_jobs(cdir)
126         j = d.get(job_id)
127         if not j or j.get("status") not in expect:
128             return None
129         j.update(updates)
130         d[job_id] = j
131         p = _path(cdir)
132         tmp = p.with_suffix(".json.tmp")
133         tmp.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
134         os.replace(str(tmp), str(p))
135         if j.get("status") not in LIVE:
136             b = _busy_read()
137             if b.get(_norm(j["repo"]), {}).get("job") == job_id:
138                 b.pop(_norm(j["repo"]), None)
139                 _busy_write(b)
140         return dict(j)

148 def start(cdir, repo, brief, check="", engine_factory=None, steward=""):
149     """Start a code job for the steward at ``cdir``: a worktree of ``repo`` and a coder engine given ``brief``.
150     ``engine_factory(worktree) -> engine`` is the seam (steward_routes passes get_engine)."""
151     brief = str(brief or "").strip()
152     if not brief:
153         return {"ok": False, "error": "a code job needs a brief"}
154     root = _repo_root(repo or "")
155     if root is None:
156         return {"ok": False, "error": "not a git repository: %s" % repo}
157     job_id = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S") + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
158     branch = "steward-job-" + job_id
159     wt = jobs_base() / job_id
160     with _LOCK:      # the check, the worktree and the busy entry: one step, so two stewards never both start
161         if _norm(root) in busy_repos():
162             return {"ok": False, "error": "a code job is already running on %s; one writer at a time" % root}
163         code, base, err = _git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
164         if code != 0:
165             return {"ok": False, "error": "the repository has no commit to start from: %s" % err}
166         code, _, err = _git(root, "worktree", "add", "-b", branch, str(wt), base, timeout=600)
167         if code != 0:
168             return {"ok": False, "error": "could not make the worktree: %s" % err[:300]}
169         job = {"id": job_id, "repo": str(root), "branch": branch, "worktree": str(wt), "base": base, "brief": brief[:8000],
170                "check": str(check or "")[:500], "status": "running", "started": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
171                "steward_dir": str(cdir), "steward": steward}
172         _write_job(cdir, job)
173         b = _busy_read()
174         b[_norm(root)] = {"job": job_id, "cdir": str(cdir)}
175         _busy_write(b)
176     # the coder's own folder record: one workbench terminal
177     terms = Path(wt) / ".anchor" / "steward-terms.json"
178     terms.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
179     terms.write_text(json.dumps({"1": {"label": "code job " + job_id, "created": job["started"], "archived": False}}), encoding="utf-8")
180     _exclude_local(wt)
181     try:
182         eng = engine_factory(str(wt)) if engine_factory else None
183         if eng is None:
184             raise RuntimeError("no engine slot for the coder")
185         eng.code_job = {"cdir": str(cdir), "id": job_id, "repo": str(root)}
186         eng.on_turn_done = lambda result: threading.Thread(target=finish, args=(cdir, job_id, result), name="code-job-" + job_id, daemon=True).start()
187         ok, why = eng.wake(fresh=True, seed=coder_brief(job))
188         if not ok:
189             raise RuntimeError(why)
190     except Exception as e:
191         j = _transition(cdir, job_id, LIVE, status="failed", finished=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), error="the coder could not start: %s" % e)
192         _cleanup(j or job, keep_branch=False)
193         return {"ok": False, "error": "the coder could not start: %s" % e, "job": job_id}
194     return {"ok": True, "job": job_id, "branch": branch, "worktree": str(wt)}

197 def _exclude_local(wt):
198     """The coder's .anchor/.ecgberht bookkeeping never lands in the repository."""
199     try:
200         code, gitdir, _ = _git(wt, "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
201         if code == 0:
202             ex = Path(wt, gitdir) if not os.path.isabs(gitdir) else Path(gitdir)
203             f = ex / "info" / "exclude"
204             f.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
205             cur = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if f.exists() else ""
206             add = [x for x in ("/.anchor/", "/.ecgberht/") if x not in cur]
207             if add:
208                 f.write_text(cur.rstrip("\n") + ("\n" if cur else "") + "\n".join(add) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
209     except Exception:
210         pass

215             "%s on branch %s. Do the work in the brief below completely, at your best; you may use sub-agents if "
216             "the brief asks for a swarm. Do not ask questions back: if something is genuinely John's to decide, "

223 def finish(cdir, job_id, result):
224     """The coder's turn ended: check, commit, land when clean, wake the steward with the result. Never raises.
225     The job is claimed first (running -> finishing): a stop that already won leaves it alone."""
226     job = _transition(cdir, job_id, ("running",), status="finishing", finishing_at=time.time())
227     if not job:
228         return
229     try:
230         _finish(cdir, job_id, job, result)
231     except Exception as e:      # never leave the repository owned by a finish that died
232         j = _transition(cdir, job_id, ("finishing",), status="failed", finished=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
233                         error="the job's finish failed: %s" % e, land_note="not landed; the work waits on branch %s" % job["branch"])
234         if j:
235             _report(cdir, j)

238 def _finish(cdir, job_id, job, result):
239     wt, repo = job["worktree"], job["repo"]
240     summary = str((result or {}).get("text") or "")[-1500:]
241     err = str((result or {}).get("error") or "")
242     check_out, check_ok = "", None
243     if job.get("check") and not err:
244         try:
245             r = subprocess.run(job["check"], cwd=wt, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=CHECK_TIMEOUT_S)
246             check_ok = r.returncode == 0
247             check_out = ((r.stdout or "") + (r.stderr or ""))[-1200:]
248         except Exception as e:
249             check_ok, check_out = False, "the check did not run: %s" % e
250     commit_err = ""
251     files = []
252     code, _, gerr = _git(wt, "add", "-A", timeout=600)
253     if code != 0:
254         commit_err = "git add failed: " + gerr[:250]
255     if not commit_err:
256         code, staged, gerr = _git(wt, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", timeout=600)
257         if code != 0:
258             commit_err = "git diff failed: " + gerr[:250]
259         elif staged:
260             code, out, gerr = _git(wt, "commit", "-q", "-m", "Code job %s for the steward\n\n%s" % (job_id, job["brief"][:600]), timeout=600)
261             if code != 0:
262                 commit_err = "git commit failed: " + (gerr or out)[:250]
263     if not commit_err:
264         # the change is what the branch holds beyond its base (the coder may have committed itself)
265         code, names, gerr = _git(wt, "diff", "--name-only", job["base"], "HEAD", timeout=600)
266         if code != 0:
267             commit_err = "git diff failed: " + gerr[:250]
268         else:
269             files = [n for n in names.splitlines() if n.strip()]
270     landed, land_note = False, ""
271     if commit_err:
272         land_note = "not landed: the commit failed (%s); the worktree is kept at %s" % (commit_err, wt)
273     elif not files:
274         land_note = "nothing changed"
275     elif err:
276         land_note = "not landed: the coder's turn ended in an error; the work waits on branch %s" % job["branch"]
277     elif check_ok is False:
278         land_note = "not landed: the check failed; the work waits on branch %s" % job["branch"]
279     else:
280         landed, land_note = land(job, files)
281     done = _transition(cdir, job_id, ("finishing",), status="failed" if (err or commit_err) else "done",
282                        finished=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), summary=summary, error=err or commit_err,
283                        check_ok=check_ok, check_output=check_out, files=files, landed=landed, land_note=land_note)
284     if done is None:
285         return
286     if not commit_err:
287         _cleanup(done, keep_branch=not (landed or not files))
288     _report(cdir, done)

291 def land(job, files):
292     """A2 (PROPOSAL v0.3): bring the job's branch up to the repository's current HEAD inside the job's OWN worktree
293     (never in the shared tree), re-run its check there, then land only its own files with git_safety.land, which
294     refuses any file someone else has changed or staged and commits by path. Returns (landed, note)."""
295     import git_safety as _gs
296     repo, wt = job["repo"], job["worktree"]
297     with _gs.repo_lock(repo, wait_s=300, who="code job " + job["id"]) as held:
298         if not held:
299             return False, "not landed: the repository's commit lock is busy; the work waits on branch %s" % job["branch"]
300         return _land_under_lock(job, _gs)
301 
302 
303 def _land_under_lock(job, _gs):
304     repo, wt = job["repo"], job["worktree"]
305     code, head, err = _git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
306     if code != 0:
307         return False, "not landed: could not read %s HEAD (%s)" % (repo, err[:120])
308     code, out, err = _git(wt, "merge", "--no-edit", head, timeout=600)       # the job's own worktree: safe
309     if code != 0:
310         _git(wt, "merge", "--abort")
311         return False, "not landed: the work conflicts with newer changes in %s; it waits on branch %s" % (repo, job["branch"])
312     if job.get("check"):
313         try:
314             r = subprocess.run(job["check"], cwd=wt, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=CHECK_TIMEOUT_S)
315             if r.returncode != 0:
316                 return False, "not landed: the check failed after bringing in newer changes; the work waits on branch %s" % job["branch"]
317         except Exception as e:
318             return False, "not landed: the check could not run after integration (%s)" % e
319     code, src, _ = _git(wt, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
320     code2, names, _ = _git(wt, "diff", "--name-only", head, src)
321     if code != 0 or code2 != 0:
322         return False, "not landed: could not read the integrated change"
323     land_files = [n for n in names.splitlines() if n.strip()]
324     if not land_files:
325         return False, "nothing changed beyond what %s already has" % repo
326     return _gs.land_locked(repo, src, land_files, "Code job %s for the steward\n\n%s" % (job["id"], job["brief"][:600]),
327                            who="code job " + job["id"], expect_head=head)
328

330 def _cleanup(job, keep_branch=True):
331     """The worktree goes; the branch goes only when there is nothing on it worth keeping."""
332     try:
333         _git(job["repo"], "worktree", "remove", "--force", job["worktree"], timeout=300)
334         if not keep_branch:
335             _git(job["repo"], "branch", "-D", job["branch"])
336     except Exception:
337         pass

340 def live_note(job):
341     """Landed is not live (his word, 2026-10-05: a tile repair 'landed with all 20 checks passing' and nothing on his
342     screen changed - the running Anchor still had the old code and his page the old stylesheet). For a job landed in the
343     repository the Anchor service runs from, the one sentence the steward must carry: it waits for a restart."""
344     if not job.get("landed"):
345         return ""
346     try:
347         here = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
348         if Path(str(job.get("repo") or "")).resolve() != here:
349             return ""
350     except Exception:
351         return ""
352     return ("NOT LIVE YET: this landed in Anchor's repository, but John's screen runs the build that was started before "
353             "it - the change shows only after Anchor restarts (an Anchor restart is John's word, or his standing "
354             "'restart when idle'). Tell him it is landed and waits for a restart; never call it installed, live or done "
355             "on his screen until the running build carries it.")

358 def _report(cdir, job):
359     """Wake the steward that commissioned the job with its result (a control turn, not his words)."""
360     lines = ["(code job %s finished - not John) Status: %s." % (job["id"], job["status"])]
361     if job.get("error"):
362         lines.append("Error: " + job["error"][:300])
363     if job.get("files"):
364         lines.append("Files: " + ", ".join(job["files"][:20]) + (" and %d more" % (len(job["files"]) - 20) if len(job["files"]) > 20 else ""))
365     if job.get("check"):
366         lines.append("Check `%s`: %s." % (job["check"], "passed" if job.get("check_ok") else "FAILED") + ((" Output tail: " + job["check_output"][-400:]) if job.get("check_ok") is False else ""))
367     lines.append("Landing: " + job.get("land_note", ""))
368     live = live_note(job)
369     if live:
370         lines.append(live)
371     lines.append("The coder's summary: " + (job.get("summary") or "(none)"))
372     lines.append("Tell John the result in two or three plain sentences; ask him only what is genuinely his to decide.")
373     try:
374         from steward_cockpit import steward_routes as _sr
375         eng = _sr.get_engine(str(cdir))
376         if eng is not None:
377             if not eng.alive():
378                 eng.wake(fresh=False)
379             eng.say("\n".join(lines), human=False)
380     except Exception:
381         pass

384 def stop(cdir, job_id=None, engine_lookup=None):
385     """His "stop": kill the running job (the newest when no id); its work so far stays on its branch."""
386     jobs = [j for j in read_jobs(cdir).values() if j.get("status") in LIVE and (not job_id or j["id"] == job_id)]
387     if not jobs:
388         return {"ok": False, "error": "no code job is running"}
389     job = sorted(jobs, key=lambda j: j["started"])[-1]
390     if job.get("status") == "finishing":
391         if time.time() - float(job.get("finishing_at") or 0) < CHECK_TIMEOUT_S + 900:
392             return {"ok": False, "error": "the code job is already finishing; its result is on the way"}
393         _transition(cdir, job["id"], ("finishing",), status="failed", finished=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
394                     error="the job's finish never completed", land_note="released by stop; the work waits on branch %s" % job["branch"])
395         return {"ok": True, "job": job["id"], "branch": job["branch"], "released": True}
396     stopped = _transition(cdir, job["id"], ("running",), status="stopped", finished=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
397                           land_note="stopped by John; nothing landed; the work so far stays on branch %s" % job["branch"])
398     if stopped is None:
399         return {"ok": False, "error": "the code job is already finishing; its result is on the way"}
400     try:
401         eng = engine_lookup(job["worktree"]) if engine_lookup else None
402         if eng is not None:
403             eng.on_turn_done = None
404             eng.stop()
405     except Exception:
406         pass
407     try:
408         _git(job["worktree"], "add", "-A")
409         _git(job["worktree"], "commit", "-q", "-m", "Code job %s stopped by John (unfinished)" % job["id"])
410         _git(job["repo"], "worktree", "remove", "--force", job["worktree"], timeout=300)
411     except Exception:
412         pass
413     return {"ok": True, "job": job["id"], "branch": job["branch"]}
